notice: Draft awaiting a human signer. An agent drafted every row; no bar applies and no build gates on this file until the founder names a signer and that person signs.
method: Each expected item was chosen from the named outside source before the index was read. The index was then searched by identifier and by title. An expected item the index lacks is a data gap. A record of the same work under another edition, reprint or translation counts as held and is listed in index_ids. A row lists every acceptable answer under expected; a hit on any of them counts. citation_verified stays false until a person checks the outside source and adds the page or section.
